scope: Run a real held-out exact-token perplexity sanity check for the own-Coder IQ4_XS+IQ4_NL artifact against its own-288 BF16 source, then measure warm short-prompt and 4K code-prompt Strata throughput on B550.
canonical_change: tools/patches/llama-perplexity-token-file.patch adds exact little-endian int32 token input to the pinned llama.cpp perplexity tool

host.post_run_state: both GPUs idle at 1 MiB used and 0 percent utilization; no compute process remained

perplexity.method: llama-perplexity with context 1024, two non-overlapping chunks, and the tool's last-half-of-context scoring; 1024 target positions are scored

bf16_source_control.first_attempt: An unbounded -ngl all control exited 1 after trying to allocate a 71189 MiB CUDA0 tensor; no PPL was claimed from that attempt.

comparison.interpretation: The quantized artifact is close to its BF16 source and the small lower PPL is well inside the reported uncertainty; this is a not-garbage sanity check, not evidence of a true quality gain.

configuration.mode: two-GPU layer split auto, native IQ pack, neutral 13824-pair profile, auto expert cache, INT8 KV, direct PLE, context 8192, prompt cache off, short reads off, no MTP

mtp_attempt.blocker: strata serve: mtp: the draft layer needs the native head (--native)
mtp_attempt.reason: The own-Coder artifact intentionally preserves BF16 output; no foreign quantized head was substituted for this throughput claim.

short_prompt.workload: tools/serve_load.py, one client, 128 output tokens, thinking off; six identical requests with the first discarded

prompt_4k_code.workload: first 4000 real tokens from the Strata tools Python corpus, tokenized with the artifact tokenizer; server saw 4027 prompt tokens including template; five fresh-prompt requests of 128 output tokens after a short generic warm-up
prompt_4k_code.suffix_drafts: 62 offered and 62 accepted in every measured request
prompt_4k_code.expert_cache_hit: 99.4 percent on the first 4K request and 100 percent on the four repeats

checks.name: exact-token-perplexity-bf16-control
checks.command: patched llama-perplexity --token-file heldout-seq0-2048.i32 -c 1024 --chunks 2 --ppl-stride 0 with bounded GPU placement

checks.name: 4k-code-throughput
checks.command: own_coder_4k_bench.py: one generic warm-up plus five fresh 4027-token prompt requests

non_claims: Perplexity uses one held-out sequence and 1024 scored positions; it is not a corpus-wide quality score or task benchmark.
The 2.31 percent lower quantized PPL is within uncertainty and does not prove improved quality.
Throughput requests repeat identical prompts, so suffix-draft acceptance and cache hit rates are not representative of varied fresh user traffic.
The 4K first request is included in all-five medians and excluded from the last-four warm subset; both values are reported.
MTP is unmeasured because the existing draft runtime refuses the source-preserving BF16 main head; these numbers must not be compared to the prior MTP baseline.
No 32K prompt, varied-prompt interleave, concurrent clients, power measurement, Tetra deployment, or external-model comparison is claimed.
